statement.zh: Mackay《Chanhu-daro Excavations, 1935–36》(1943) 正式报告昌胡-达罗发掘，含哈拉帕文化层与朱卡尔层及手工业证据。
statement.en: Mackay’s Chanhu-daro Excavations, 1935–36 (1943) formally reports the site, including Harappan and Jhukar levels and craft evidence.
